name: Ace's Baseball Bat
blocked_sentences: As long as equipped creature is attacking, it has first strike and must be blocked by a Dalek if able.

needs.what: an attacker-side block requirement static: as long as the affected creature (here `affects: {attached: true, attacking: true}`) is attacking, the defending player must block it with at least one creature matching a blocker filter (here `subtypes: ["Dalek"]`) if able (509.1c), enforced in combat.blocks_valid / unmet_block_requirements beside provoke and the lure family
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `block_restriction` is the opposite direction (narrows who MAY block, 'can't be blocked except by'); the `must_block` op is a one-shot flag on a specific blocker naming an attacker, set by a resolving effect, so it cannot express a continuous requirement that applies to whichever Daleks the defender controls at declare-blockers; `must_block_any` names no attacker and is likewise a one-shot op. The first-strike half is expressible (grant_keyword static on attached+attacking) but the sentence cannot be split without dropping the Dalek clause
